method: Natural high-tier completed-Mega prefix shared by both render tiers; physical approach and E, protection off before release. Full credits sampled every 10 seconds using fixed simulation stepping; not a real-time performance test. Repeat viewing is a constructed replay carrying epilogueSeen earned by an actual first viewing; physical W skips. Credits skip used actual clickable button. Every listed frame was opened in contact sheets.
observations: Both tiers: release to title 3900 ticks (65 s), credits begin 4200 ticks, thanks 9600 ticks, menu 9960 ticks; credits phase lasts 5400 ticks (90 s). Player and corgi remained at 100 HP in recorded immune observations. Both physical repeat-view skip inputs jumped from 541 to 3902 elapsed ticks. Physical credits skip reached thanks in two ticks.
open: Delivered cue at 50 s, journey/survivor shots, continuous credits readability and exact visual kneeling are not established; PO must judge whether 60 s and title frames communicate a full-L10 pullback. No verdict written while objective clauses remain open.
